name: Isola Grand Event Collection
description: Adds the Isola Grand Event Collection, the owner's large collection of island events (written with ChatGPT; the credits come with it, in "Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher Files\Events\Credits.txt"). Each natural island event has a 30-50% chance to be one of these instead (never a rescue event or the two opening events). Events that can kill a villager, make one disappear or lose a pregnancy only happen once the village has 61 or more villagers. From 61 villagers the food and tech points they give or take come in a random size each time (small, normal, large or huge, in the game's own ranges). When one of these events -- or one of More Island Events' -- comes (Story / Cheat Upgrades), the game's own event does not come that time; never while the village is in trouble (the game's own rescue rule, little food, much sickness, few grown villagers), and when none can happen, the game's own event comes. It never takes a share of the game's own draw, so the game's own events keep their chances among themselves. Each event needs the villagers it names (never the protected ones for anything harmful); when it cannot be cast, another is drawn. Pick Island Event lists them (with what each needs), and the Custom Island Event library has them in its own "Isola Grand Event Collection" group. 4360 events in this game in this build. The Living Event Engine adds 215 situations, each shown as one of its owner-written variants with the villagers' names (each category counts as one event in the draw). Off by default; Owner's Defaults, Select All and Classic VV Difficulty (The Tree of Life, New Believers) tick it, with More Island Events (the "More Island Events and Creator" row). **Needs Story / Cheat Upgrades (on by default), which runs these events; ticking this ticks it.** **Needs Scrolling Popups, which keeps every page of these events on the screen; ticking this ticks it.** **Unverified in play: the events have not been seen in a running game** (emulated).
behavior_changes: Story / Cheat Upgrades (native/vvfp_story_upgrades/story_collection.inc), once for each natural island event, 3 seconds before it is due with nothing armed or on its way (and no God Power armed in New Believers): past the two opening events and outside trouble (the stock rescue predicate, little food, much sickness, few grown villagers), the game's own random routine rolls a chance in 30..50 percent and then passes it, and one new event is armed in the natural one's place; below 61 villagers (the living villagers the game lists and the babies being carried; New Believers' believers only) an event that can kill, make a villager disappear or lose a pregnancy is left out of the draw (unless No Safeguards for Island Events (and Additional Events too) is installed). From 61 villagers each food or tech-point effect of a new event takes a random size (small, normal, large or huge, the game's own ranges; a gain stays a gain, a loss a loss). Every event that can happen is equally likely, More Island Events' and the collection's alike: one draw over all of them, each collection event by its draw weight (1), a series as one event; when none can be cast the game's own event comes. The event is armed as a purchase arms one, and the island timer's keeper is then given a new natural time after it, drawn as the game's own trigger draws one (12-23, 10-19 or 8-15 hours), so the new event takes the natural event's place.

The events of this game are compiled .cieg files in "Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher Files\Events" (each named by its number, data/event_collection/file_numbers.tsv), listed in its *.lst files (one per source section and living series); Pick Island Event lists them (strict casting: every requirement must hold) and the in-game library's "Isola Grand Event Collection" group sells them (the library's casting: a requirement nobody meets is dropped, the protected villagers' safety never).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched and no island event of the game's own changes, nor its chance among the game's own events: the stock draw is never widened. A natural event a new event replaces does not come that time; the next natural time is drawn as the game's own trigger draws it.
Nothing is written to the save; the due roll is kept beside it, deleted once delivered or cancelled.
evidence_status: the roll, its edge, its rates, the due time, the waits, the trouble guard, the choice and the save's file emulated in tests/test_collection_trigger.py; the files and the rows in tests/test_event_collection_package.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
